140	RETURNS void
141	LANGUAGE plpgsql
142	SECURITY DEFINER

144	DECLARE
145	  v_studio_id uuid;
146	BEGIN
147	  SELECT fe.studio_id INTO v_studio_id
148	  FROM flash_event_slots fes
149	  INNER JOIN flash_events fe ON fe.id = fes.flash_event_id
150	  WHERE fes.id = p_slot_id;
151	
152	  IF NOT EXISTS (
153	    SELECT 1 FROM studio_members
154	    WHERE studio_id = v_studio_id
155	      AND user_id = auth.uid()
156	      AND deactivated_at IS NULL
157	  ) THEN
158	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden';
159	  END IF;
160	END;
161	$$;

163	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION _flash_assert_studio_member_for_event(p_event_id uuid)
164	RETURNS void
165	LANGUAGE plpgsql
166	SECURITY DEFINER
167	AS $$
168	DECLARE
169	  v_studio_id uuid;
170	BEGIN
171	  SELECT studio_id INTO v_studio_id
172	  FROM flash_events
173	  WHERE id = p_event_id;
174	
175	  IF NOT EXISTS (
176	    SELECT 1 FROM studio_members
177	    WHERE studio_id = v_studio_id
178	      AND user_id = auth.uid()
179	      AND deactivated_at IS NULL
180	  ) THEN
181	    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden';
182	  END IF;
183	END;
184	$$;
185	
186	
187	-- ============================================================
188	-- SECTION 8 — RPC: mark_flash_slot_walkin
189	--
190	-- Called from a server action using the service-role client
191	-- (no auth.uid() available), so no membership check here.
192	-- Creates a client upsert, a bookings row, then transitions
193	-- the slot directly open → booked (skipping reserved).
194	-- Returns: { booking_id, booking_token, slot_id } or { error }
195	-- ============================================================
196	
197	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mark_flash_slot_walkin(
198	  p_slot_id        uuid,
199	  p_client_info    jsonb,    -- { first_name, last_name?, email, phone?, notes? }
200	  p_charge_at_desk boolean   -- hint for the caller; stored in booking metadata
201	)
202	RETURNS jsonb
203	LANGUAGE plpgsql
204	SECURITY DEFINER
205	AS $$
206	DECLARE
207	  v_slot          flash_event_slots%ROWTYPE;
208	  v_event         flash_events%ROWTYPE;
209	  v_client_id     uuid;
210	  v_booking_id    uuid;
211	  v_booking_token text;
212	  v_artist_id     uuid;
213	BEGIN
214	  -- Lock the slot atomically; skip if already locked by concurrent request
215	  SELECT * INTO v_slot
216	  FROM flash_event_slots
217	  WHERE id = p_slot_id
218	    AND status = 'open'
219	  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;
220	
221	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
222	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'slot_unavailable');
223	  END IF;
224	
225	  -- Resolve parent event
226	  SELECT * INTO v_event FROM flash_events WHERE id = v_slot.flash_event_id;
227	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
228	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'event_not_found');
229	  END IF;
230	
231	  -- Upsert client by email scoped to this studio (mirrors public_reserve_flash_slot)
232	  INSERT INTO clients (studio_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, source, created_at, updated_at)
233	  VALUES (
234	    v_event.studio_id,
235	    p_client_info->>'first_name',
236	    NULLIF(p_client_info->>'last_name', ''),
237	    LOWER(TRIM(p_client_info->>'email')),
238	    NULLIF(p_client_info->>'phone', ''),
239	    'walk-in',
240	    now(),
241	    now()
242	  )
243	  ON CONFLICT (studio_id, email) DO UPDATE
244	    SET updated_at = now()
245	  RETURNING id INTO v_client_id;
246	
247	  -- Resolve artist (event artist → first active studio artist)
248	  v_artist_id := v_event.artist_id;
249	  IF v_artist_id IS NULL THEN
250	    SELECT id INTO v_artist_id
251	    FROM artists
252	    WHERE studio_id = v_event.studio_id AND status = 'active'
253	    ORDER BY sort_order
254	    LIMIT 1;
255	  END IF;
256	
257	  IF v_artist_id IS NULL THEN
258	    RETURN jsonb_build_object('error', 'no_artist_available');
259	  END IF;
260	
261	  -- Generate IDs
262	  v_booking_token := gen_random_uuid()::text;
263	  v_booking_id    := gen_random_uuid();
264	
265	  -- Create booking row (status=pending; payment collected at desk separately)
266	  INSERT INTO bookings (
267	    id, studio_id, client_id, artist_id,
268	    scheduled_at, duration_min,
269	    status, price_cents, deposit_cents, deposit_paid,
270	    booking_token, source,
271	    notes, client_notes,
272	    location_id, metadata,
273	    consent_required,
274	    created_at, updated_at
275	  ) VALUES (
276	    v_booking_id,
277	    v_event.studio_id,
278	    v_client_id,
279	    v_artist_id,
280	    v_slot.slot_start,
281	    (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (v_slot.slot_end - v_slot.slot_start)) / 60)::int,
282	    'pending',
283	    v_event.slot_price_cents,
284	    0,         -- walk-ins pay at desk; no online deposit
285	    false,
286	    v_booking_token,
287	    'walk-in',
288	    NULLIF(p_client_info->>'notes', ''),
289	    NULL,
290	    v_event.location_id,
291	    jsonb_build_object(
292	      'flash_event_id',   v_event.id,
293	      'flash_event_slug', v_event.slug,
294	      'walk_in',          true,
295	      'charge_at_desk',   p_charge_at_desk
296	    ),
297	    false,
298	    now(),
299	    now()
300	  );
301	
302	  -- Transition slot directly to booked (walk-in skips reserved state)
303	  UPDATE flash_event_slots
304	  SET status         = 'booked',
305	      booking_id     = v_booking_id,
306	      walk_in        = true,
307	      reserved_until = NULL,
308	      -- grace window starts from slot_start, not now()
309	      grace_expires_at = v_slot.slot_start + interval '15 minutes'
310	  WHERE id = v_slot.id;
311	
312	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
313	    'booking_id',    v_booking_id,
314	    'booking_token', v_booking_token,
315	    'slot_id',       v_slot.id
316	  );
317	END;
318	$$;

321	-- ============================================================
322	-- SECTION 9 — RPC: mark_flash_slot_no_show
323	--
324	-- Staff-facing. Validates slot is 'booked' and not yet checked in.
325	-- Sets status='no_show', mirrors to the linked booking row.
326	-- Returns true if transition occurred.
327	-- ============================================================
328	
329	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mark_flash_slot_no_show(p_slot_id uuid)
330	RETURNS boolean
331	LANGUAGE plpgsql
332	SECURITY DEFINER
333	AS $$
334	DECLARE
335	  v_slot flash_event_slots%ROWTYPE;
336	BEGIN
337	  -- Membership guard: caller must be an active studio member
338	  PERFORM _flash_assert_studio_member_for_slot(p_slot_id);
339	
340	  -- Lock and validate slot state
341	  SELECT * INTO v_slot
342	  FROM flash_event_slots
343	  WHERE id = p_slot_id
344	    AND status = 'booked'
345	    AND checked_in_at IS NULL
346	  FOR UPDATE;
347	
348	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
349	    RETURN false;  -- Already no-show, not booked, or already checked in
350	  END IF;
351	
352	  -- Transition slot
353	  UPDATE flash_event_slots
354	  SET status            = 'no_show',
355	      no_show_marked_at = now()
356	  WHERE id = p_slot_id;
357	
358	  -- Mirror status to booking row so booking list reflects reality
359	  UPDATE bookings
360	  SET status     = 'no_show',
361	      updated_at = now()
362	  WHERE id = v_slot.booking_id;
363	
364	  RETURN true;
365	END;
366	$$;
367	
368	
369	-- ============================================================
370	-- SECTION 10 — RPC: mark_flash_slot_checked_in
371	--
372	-- Staff-facing. Validates slot is 'booked'. Sets checked_in_at=now().
373	-- Idempotent: calling a second time is a no-op (returns true).
374	-- ============================================================
375	
376	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION mark_flash_slot_checked_in(p_slot_id uuid)
377	RETURNS boolean
378	LANGUAGE plpgsql
379	SECURITY DEFINER
380	AS $$
381	BEGIN
382	  -- Membership guard
383	  PERFORM _flash_assert_studio_member_for_slot(p_slot_id);
384	
385	  -- Only act if slot is booked (any checked_in_at state — idempotent)
386	  UPDATE flash_event_slots
387	  SET checked_in_at = COALESCE(checked_in_at, now())
388	  WHERE id = p_slot_id
389	    AND status = 'booked';
390	
391	  RETURN FOUND;
392	END;
393	$$;
394	
395	
396	-- ============================================================
397	-- SECTION 11 — RPC: duplicate_flash_event
398	--
399	-- Staff-facing. Deep-copies event + designs; skips slots.
400	-- New event: status='draft', event_date = today + 14 days,
401	-- slug appended with '-copy-<epoch>'.
402	-- ============================================================
403	
404	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION duplicate_flash_event(p_event_id uuid)
405	RETURNS uuid
406	LANGUAGE plpgsql
407	SECURITY DEFINER
408	AS $$
409	DECLARE
410	  v_src    flash_events%ROWTYPE;
411	  v_new_id uuid;

All 17 flash-events tests pass. Now I have everything to deliver the verdict.

### Verdict
APPROVE_WITH_FOLLOWUPS

### Critical Findings (block-level)

**1. Cron sweep will fail every tick — `mark_flash_slot_no_show` enforces studio-membership via `auth.uid()`, but service-role context has no `auth.uid()`.**
- `supabase/migrations/20260428100000_flash_events_audit_v1.sql:338` — `PERFORM _flash_assert_studio_member_for_slot(p_slot_id)` runs inside `mark_flash_slot_no_show`.
- `_flash_assert_studio_member_for_slot` checks `user_id = auth.uid()` (line 155). In service-role connection `auth.uid()` returns NULL → EXISTS is false → `RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden'`.
- Both `lib/flash-events/no-show-sweep.ts:59` (cron path) and `workers/cron/flash-no-show-sweep.ts:59` invoke this RPC with the service-role client. Every cron run will throw `forbidden`, swept stays 0, no slot ever auto-transitions to no_show.
- **Fix options:** (a) split into two RPCs — staff-facing (with guard) + system-facing (no guard, callable only by service role); or (b) modify the helper to no-op when `auth.uid()` IS NULL (acceptable because service-role connection is itself privileged); or (c) move the cron sweep to a direct UPDATE…WHERE on the table using service-role and skip the RPC entirely.

**2. Server route is not feature-gated for `flash_events` (Studio+).**
- `app/(app)/flash-events/page.tsx` calls `requirePersona(['studio_owner'])` and `getAuthenticatedUser`, but never `requireFeatureRpc(supabase, studioId, 'flash_events')`. Existing pattern at `app/(app)/messages/page.tsx:60` is the contract.
- `app/(app)/flash-events/[id]/page.tsx` likewise has no server feature gate.
- No `<FeatureGate feature="flash_events">` anywhere in `components/flash-events/`. A Solo-tier studio can render the page and see all data.
- Note: `requireFeature` is currently a dev-mode pass-through (`feature-gate.ts:131`), but the Stack A non-negotiable is to call it anyway so the gate trips on flip-day. Bypass is not optional.
- **Fix:** add `await requireFeatureRpc(supabase, auth.studioId, 'flash_events')` (with `FeatureGateError` 403 → upsell redirect) at the top of both pages, plus a `<FeatureGate feature="flash_events">` wrapping `<FlashEventsListClient>` and `<FlashEventDetailShell>`. Also gate the revenue panel UI behind `analytics` (Studio+) and the SMS reminder action behind `sms_reminders`.

### Warnings (non-blocking, future-fix)
- Eight mutation actions are not audit-logged: `publishFlashEventAction`, `cancelFlashEventAction`, `deleteFlashEventAction`, `addDesignAction`, `updateDesignAction`, `removeDesignAction`, `reorderDesignsAction`, `blockSlotAction`, `unblockSlotAction`. Spec only requires the 8 new ones (which all log correctly), but parity matters.
- `walkInSchema` accepts any non-empty `firstName` but no length floor on `email` beyond `.email()` — acceptable but mirror the booking schema for consistency.
- `closeFlashEventAction` casts the summary jsonb via `(summary as unknown) as Json` — TS-clean but lose the typed shape; consider a Zod parse on the boundary.
- `chk_flash_slot_booked_has_booking` is correct; `mark_flash_slot_walkin` creates the booking before transitioning to `booked`, so no integrity violation.
- `auth.uid()` insert into `flash_events.created_by` (line 461 of migration) inside `duplicate_flash_event` is fine — the RPC is staff-facing, not cron.

### Compliance Summary
- Feature gating: ✗ — server gate missing on both pages; no `<FeatureGate>` wrapper; sub-features `analytics` + `sms_reminders` ungated (CRITICAL #2)
- RLS: ✗ — `mark_flash_slot_no_show` membership guard breaks cron path (CRITICAL #1). All other RPCs (`mark_flash_slot_walkin` rightly skipped, `mark_flash_slot_checked_in` / `duplicate` / `close` correctly guarded)
- Audit log: ✓ for the 8 new mutations; partial gap on legacy mutations (warning)
- TypeScript strict: ✓ — zero `any`/`as any`/`@ts-ignore` in audited paths; typed-RPC casts via `as unknown as` are acceptable. Pre-existing typecheck errors are in `lib/today/queries.ts` + `scripts/seed/demo/modules/{flash-inventory,studio}.ts` + `reset.ts` — unrelated to this change-set
- Brand: ✓ — only the 2 expected QR hex literals in `EventShareCard.tsx` (Onyx/Bone). No default Tailwind shadows, no `console.*`, no `tailwind.config.ts`, no green/red/blue/amber color drift
- Migrations: ✓ — DOWN comments present, backfill before constraint add (Section 4 → Section 5), idempotent column adds via `EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_column`, all params prefixed `p_`, no destructive UPDATE without WHERE
- Performance: ✓ — `getFlashEvent`/`getFlashEventSlots` join in single round-trip; bulk booking fetch in `listFlashEvents` confirmed; cron query is index-backed by `idx_flash_event_slots_grace`
- Forbidden imports: ✓ — no Stripe / Prisma / NextAuth / `@supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs`

### Must-fix-before-prod (explicit, with file:line)
1. `supabase/migrations/20260428100000_flash_events_audit_v1.sql:329-366` — make `mark_flash_slot_no_show` cron-safe. Recommended: change `_flash_assert_studio_member_for_slot` to `IF auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (...) THEN RAISE 'forbidden'`. Add a follow-up migration; do not edit the existing one in place.
2. `app/(app)/flash-events/page.tsx:31-52` — add `await requireFeatureRpc(supabase, auth.studioId, 'flash_events')` after `getAuthenticatedUser`, with `FeatureGateError` → redirect to `/settings/billing?upsell=flash_events`.
3. `app/(app)/flash-events/[id]/page.tsx:18-34` — same gate.
4. `components/flash-events/FlashEventDetailShell.tsx` — wrap `<EventRevenuePanel>` in `<FeatureGate feature="analytics">` (Studio+); wrap the SMS reminder button path in `sendSlotReminderAction` callsite with `<FeatureGate feature="sms_reminders">`.

Once 1–4 are fixed, this is APPROVE. Tests are green (17 passed in flash-events suites), brand is locked, RLS+audit story is otherwise solid.
